cheng: Quick bench dump from regional sweep (us-central, eu-west, ap-northeast) comparing A100 vs H100 for RedPajama-7B and Llama2-7B-chat. Low-latency interactive workload: batch=1, prefill=384 tokens (tokenizer included), steady decode measured over 500 tokens. Quant: fp16 and qp4 (aggressive quant). Kernels: flash_attn_v3 vs cuopt_triton. Posting compact numbers + notes.

maria: drop the numbers

cheng: ```
# RedPajama-7B (batch=1, qp4)
region | GPU | prefill_ms | token_ms | tok/s | $/1M
us-central | A100 | 480 | 6.9 | 145 | $5.9
us-central | H100 | 310 | 4.0 | 250 | $3.5
eu-west | A100 | 520 | 7.3 | 137 | $6.3
ap-northeast | H100 | 340 | 4.4 | 227 | $3.9

# Llama2-7B-chat (fp16)
us-central | A100 | 460 | 6.5 | 154 | $5.6
us-central | H100 | 300 | 3.9 | 256 | $3.4

Notes: $ uses on-demand GPU runtime. qp4 gave 10-12% speedup vs fp16 on A100 but small coherence drop on long code snippets.
```

tyler: those tok/s look optimistic; kernel?

cheng: cuopt_triton on H100 with block_size tuned; flash_attn_v3 on A100. On H100, cuopt_triton beats flash_attn_v3 by ~12% for decode-heavy traces. Batch=8 snapshots: H100 ~1700 tok/s, A100 ~1050.

samir: region infra effect?

cheng: Prefill latency larger in eu-west due to older CPU SKU + nvlink version mismatch causing +30-50ms host memcpy. Steady decode mostly GPU bound. We saw p95 tail get worse when kernel fallback triggered at seq_len>4096.

anya: Any $/1M calc details?

cheng: We used on-demand per-GPU hourly cost + measured sustained tok/s during each run. Also included 5% network overhead in prefill timings.
